result.description: LumaForge Prism 27 is a fictional 27-inch OLED desktop monitor designed for color-accurate creative work and ambient presentation use. It features a 2560x1440 panel, 240 Hz refresh rate, 0.03 ms response time, DisplayPort and dual HDMI inputs, and a built-in USB-C hub for workstation docking. The product is positioned as a premium display rather than a storage device or graphics card.
result.title: LumaForge Prism 27 OLED Display
